name: figlet
description: ASCII art text generator with multiple font styles and text formatting options

figlet.description: Display large characters made up of ordinary screen characters - create ASCII art text with various fonts and styles
figlet.usage:
figlet Hello World
figlet -f big 'Big Text'
figlet -f block 'BLOCK TEXT'
echo 'Text' | figlet

chkfont.description: Check and validate FIGlet font files for compatibility and correctness
